prior_finite_result.scope: Declared finite profiles only; no general convergence claim.

questions.question: What distinguishes source coverage, snapshot consistency and currency at publication?
questions.acceptance: Primary-source-backed definitions and separate proof obligations, independently reviewed.

questions.question: How do optimistic collection and sealed windows differ in progress under ordinary concurrent updates?
questions.acceptance: Explicit assumptions and progress costs for both bounded alternatives; no production selection or unsupported liveness claim.

questions.question: What evidence permits campaign completion and publication after the amended scope?
questions.acceptance: Complete inventory distinguishes a valid finite result from resolved research, preserves old evidence and requires exact final gates/reviews.
questions.residual: Documentation validity alone cannot authorize publication.

questions.question: What precise object does an attestation authorize?
questions.acceptance: Resolve the prior static cut-binding hypothesis with admissible evidence and independent review.
questions.residual: Prior static hypothesis is unexecuted; no unsafe settlement established.

questions.question: Is the source identity contract consistently typed?
questions.acceptance: Resolve the prior static type-domain hypothesis with admissible evidence and independent review.
questions.residual: Existing constructors restrict types; broader input behavior is unproven.

questions.question: Are request identity and record position independent in the declared evidence?
questions.acceptance: Evidence covers the independently specified dimensions and ordinary valid recovery.
questions.residual: Existing finite constructors couple these dimensions.

questions.question: Which original-data obligations belong at admission versus literal classification?
questions.acceptance: A reviewed responsibility contract and admissible evidence support any implementation claim.

questions.question: Which individual conditions and valid recovery paths have distinct evidence?
questions.acceptance: Per-condition support or explicit redundancy, with positive recovery and independent review.
questions.residual: Combined checks do not independently establish every component.

questions.question: What composition evidence connects atomic and pending registration to source/readers?
questions.acceptance: Explicit comparison projection, declared composition domain and independently reviewed evidence.
questions.residual: Larger-domain and full Cartesian conclusions remain unavailable.
